hardware: Apple M4 Max, 40 Metal GPU cores, 48 GiB unified memory
model: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Q4_K_M, BF16 KV, BF16 DFlash2 sidecar, max draft depth 6
protocol: Same 4,000 input tokens, 64 greedy outputs, 15/8 warmup, GQA8 experimental BF16 attention and BF16 DFlash2. Fresh process per mode with two uncached requests; separate process with one logit dump. The second timed request checks undoing the promotion and re-entering wide prefill. No GPU profiler in timed runs.
mechanism: Keep 36 resident through prefill. At prefill return the wide scheduler scratch has already drained. After the first output, synchronize target and drafter and replace the 4,096-row DFlash2 feature buffer with an 8-row buffer. Both context graphs are invalidated before retiring old owners. The probe either loads four new resident banks or retains the last two already populated prefill banks and reads the other two. A third variant skips the initial zero-fill only where verified contiguous tensor reads overwrite the entire new buffer. Before the next prefill, return to 36 banks and restore the large feature buffer. The shared memory ledger remains capped throughout.
metrics: TTFT and client TPS are measured from SSE token arrival timestamps. TPS includes the promotion pause. A diagnostic estimate of TPS without the pause subtracts the measured promotion interval from the first-to-last interval. Whole verify time is wall from target decode through target synchronize for the 14 identical draft blocks, excluding draft and accept. Physical footprint is the process-reported lifetime peak, separate from the ledger high water.
scope: Diagnostic builds; production defaults were not edited. Timings are qualified on the recorded fixture only.
